        public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {

            String s = in.next();

            int[] kpos = new int[n], vpos = new int[n], opos = new int[n];
            int[] snk = new int[n + 1], snv = new int[n + 1], sno = new int[n + 1];

                if (ch == 'V') vpos[nv++] = i;
                else if (ch == 'K') kpos[nk++] = i;
                else opos[no++] = i;
                snk[i + 1] = nk;
                snv[i + 1] = nv;

                    for (int o = 0; o <= no; ++o) {

                            }
                            if (o < no) {
                                best[0][k][v][o + 1] = Math.min(best[0][k][v][o + 1], cur + Math.max(snv[opos[o]] - v, 0) + Math.max(snk[opos[o]] - k, 0));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            out.println(Math.min(best[0][nk][nv][no], best[1][nk][nv][no]));
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        public BufferedReader reader;
        public StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
